headline: RED / 4th Session Decline — Weak Recovery Fails, Breadth Catastrophic
marketPulseNote: NEPSE closed red on June 11, 2026 at 2728.03, down 8.14 points (-0.29%) — the 4th consecutive red session in the series (Jun 4: -0.48%, Jun 5: -0.41%, Jun 8: -0.73%, Jun 10: +0.09% green interruption, Jun 11: -0.29%). Market breadth was catastrophic: only 81 advances vs 179 declines and 13 unchanged — a 2.2:1 ratio. Total turnover Rs.3.91B (lower than Jun 10's Rs.4.30B) with 9,231,216 shares across 58,391 transactions in 350 scrips. B58 returned to NET BUYER: total purchases NPR 281,725,539 vs sales NPR 244,845,611 — net inflow of +Rs.36.88M. Key B58 activity: CITY continues as dominant buy (31.84%, 178,393 kitta), CREST now a pure B58 SELL at 56.75% (reversal from Jun 10 pure buy), KHPL both top buy (13.16%) and top sell (22.15%) — suggesting B58 is trading KHPL intraday/short-term after the stock's massive +14.99% run. RIDI sell volume collapsed (7.02%, 15,565 kitta) vs Jun 10's 55.49%. Hotels And Tourism (+0.47%) and Manufacturing (+0.26%) were the only green sub-indices. Finance fell -1.45% — sharpest sub-index decline after Trading (-1.23%) and Others (-0.91%).

keyInsights.title: NEPSE Falls Again — 4th Red Session, Breadth Worst Since Jun 8
keyInsights.body: NEPSE fell -8.14 points (-0.29%) to 2728.03 — the 4th red session in the recent series, rendering Jun 10's +2.57 green day a dead-cat bounce. Breadth was catastrophic: only 81 advances vs 179 declines (2.2:1 ratio). Turnover dropped to Rs.3.91B from Jun 10's Rs.4.30B. Hotels (+0.47%) and Manufacturing (+0.26%) were the only green sub-indices. Finance was the worst performer at -1.45% — a sharp reversal from the prior sessions where Finance was consistently green. Cumulative NEPSE decline from Jun 4 high of 2766.78: now -38.75 points.

keyInsights.title: B58 Returns to Net Buyer at +Rs.36.88M — But With New Stock Rotation
keyInsights.body: B58 returned to net buyer status: purchases NPR 281.7M vs sales NPR 244.8M, net +Rs.36.88M. However the composition has shifted significantly. CITY remains the dominant conviction buy (138,853 net kitta — largest net accumulation of Jun 11 session). New buys: UAIL (58.30%), SHL (46.46%), BANDIPUR (38.75%), NICL (25.17%). Prior tracked names NHPC, BUNGAL, BHCL, SRLI not in today's B58 top lists — market breadth was too weak for their floorsheet to show up. The return to net buying is a positive signal but the rotation into new names warrants caution.

keyInsights.title: CITY — 6th Consecutive Session of B58 Activity, Net +138,853 Kitta (Largest of Session)
keyInsights.body: CITY has now been in B58's top activity list for 6 consecutive sessions. Today's net accumulation of 138,853 kitta (178,393 bought vs 39,540 sold) is the single largest net kitta accumulation of any stock in any single session across the entire tracked series. CITY closed at 439.00 — up from 403.90 on Jun 8. Cumulative B58 net position across 6 sessions: approximately +340,000+ kitta. B58 is building a very large strategic position in CITY.

keyInsights.title: KHPL — B58 Distributing After +14.99% Run: 24,515 Kitta Sold at 22.15%
keyInsights.body: KHPL had a massive +14.99% move on Jun 10 (close 1152.00). Today B58 was the top seller at 22.15% market share (24,515 kitta, avg Rs.1,207.43) while also buying 14,511 kitta at 13.16% (1,440 transactions — an unusual number suggesting retail/algo buying). Net -10,004 kitta. With 10,877 total transactions, retail is chasing the KHPL momentum while B58 distributes. Classic institutional exit pattern. Do not buy KHPL at these levels.

keyInsights.title: CREST — Confirmed Short-Term Trading Pattern: Buy Jun 10, Sell Jun 11
keyInsights.body: CREST was B58's pure buy at 69.30% on Jun 10, then pure sell at 56.75% on Jun 11. Combined with the LBBL pattern (buy Jun 8, sell Jun 10) and the AKJCL buy-sell-buy cycle, B58 appears to be running short-term momentum trades on specific stocks while maintaining longer-term positions in CITY and NHPC. Traders should not interpret single-session B58 buys as strategic accumulation signals without confirmation across 2+ sessions.

keyInsights.title: NABIL — Complete Technical Reversal in Single Session
keyInsights.body: NABIL showed one of the most dramatic single-session technical deteriorations: ADX collapsed from 46.45 to 14.02 (trend strength entirely lost), Aroon Down surged from 0% to 92.86%, MACD signal went from +2.68 to -3.55. The stock was the 'best banking technical setup' on Jun 10; today it signals avoid. This type of single-day reversal in multiple indicators simultaneously suggests the Jun 10 reading may have been at a local peak. Reassess entirely.

keyInsights.title: UAIL and SHL — New B58 High-Conviction Buys
keyInsights.body: Two new stocks appeared on B58's buy list at very high market share: UAIL (United Insurance Company of Nepal) at 58.30% (16,710 kitta, avg Rs.486.35) and SHL (Shangrila Hotel?) at 46.46% (14,468 kitta, avg Rs.500.97). Both are pure buys with no corresponding sells. These are first appearances on the tracked list. Given B58's mixed track record on single-session pure buys (LBBL reversed in 2 days, SKBBL not confirmed), track both for 2 consecutive sessions before acting.

keyInsights.title: RIDI — 8th Session Distribution, Volume Dramatically Lower
keyInsights.body: RIDI B58 sell volume has dropped dramatically: Jun 10 was 158,232 kitta at 55.49%; Jun 11 is only 15,565 kitta at 7.02%. This could mean B58 has largely completed its RIDI exit after 8 sessions of distribution. However, no buy signal has appeared yet. The pattern to watch for: B58 appearing on RIDI's buy side would be the first re-accumulation signal. Until then, avoid.

keyInsights.title: Finance Index -1.45% — Worst Single-Day Sub-Index Drop of Series
keyInsights.body: Finance Index fell -1.45% to 2496.60 — the largest single sub-index percentage drop in the tracked series. This is a complete reversal from Finance's prior role as the consistently green sector. BFC (a Finance sector stock) also pulled back: RSI fell from 76.36 to 63.81 — now entering the 60-65 watch zone for potential entry. The Finance sector weakness may be short-term mean-reversion after its prior outperformance.

keyInsights.title: BUNGAL, BHCL, SRLI — Bullish Technical Structures Maintained
keyInsights.body: Despite the broadly red market, three stocks maintained their bullish technical structures unchanged: BUNGAL (RSI 56.27, ADX 41.00, AccDist +665K, MACD 25.58, Aroon Down 0%), BHCL (RSI 55.24, ADX 32.32, MACD 12.49, Aroon Down 0%, AD Osc Bullish), SRLI (RSI 50.09, Aroon Up 92.86%, MACD 1.88, AD Osc Bullish). These three remain the highest-quality setups in the tracked universe for patient accumulation on weakness.
